de-DE.name: Dein Festtagskarten-Foto
de-DE.shortDescription: Mach aus jedem Foto ein festliches Porträt.
de-DE.longDescription: Foto wählen, Festtagskarte tippen: Nano Banana zaubert Pullover, Lichterbaum und Schnee, jedes Gesicht bleibt.

en-AU.name: Your Holiday Card Photo
en-AU.shortDescription: Turn any photo into a cozy festive portrait.
en-AU.longDescription: Pick a photo, tap Holiday card, and Nano Banana adds sweaters, a glowing tree and snow, keeping every face as it is.

en-GB.name: Your Holiday Card Photo
en-GB.shortDescription: Turn any photo into a cozy festive portrait.
en-GB.longDescription: Pick a photo, tap Holiday card, and Nano Banana adds sweaters, a glowing tree and snow, keeping every face as it is.

en-US.name: Your Holiday Card Photo
en-US.shortDescription: Turn any photo into a cozy festive portrait.
en-US.longDescription: Pick a photo, tap Holiday card, and Nano Banana adds sweaters, a glowing tree and snow, keeping every face as it is.

es-ES.name: Tu foto de tarjeta navideña
es-ES.shortDescription: Convierte cualquier foto en un retrato festivo.
es-ES.longDescription: Elige una foto, toca Tarjeta festiva y Nano Banana añade jerséis, un árbol iluminado y nieve, sin cambiar caras.

es-MX.name: Tu foto de tarjeta navideña
es-MX.shortDescription: Convierte cualquier foto en un retrato festivo.
es-MX.longDescription: Elige una foto, toca Tarjeta festiva y Nano Banana añade suéteres, un árbol iluminado y nieve, sin cambiar caras.

fr-FR.name: Votre photo de carte de fêtes
fr-FR.shortDescription: Un portrait festif à partir de votre photo.
fr-FR.longDescription: Choisissez une photo, touchez Carte de fêtes : Nano Banana ajoute pulls, sapin illuminé et neige, visages intacts.

it.name: La tua foto per gli auguri
it.shortDescription: Trasforma ogni foto in un ritratto festivo.
it.longDescription: Scegli una foto, tocca Biglietto festivo e Nano Banana aggiunge maglioni, albero luminoso e neve, volti intatti.

ja.name: ホリデーカード写真を作ろう
ja.shortDescription: どんな写真も温かなお祝いポートレートに。
ja.longDescription: 写真を選んで「ホリデーカード」をタップ。Nano Bananaがセーターや輝くツリー、雪を加え、顔はそのまま。

ko.name: 나만의 홀리데이 카드 사진
ko.longDescription: 사진을 고르고 홀리데이 카드를 누르면 Nano Banana가 스웨터, 빛나는 트리, 눈을 더하고 얼굴은 그대로 지켜요.

pl.name: Twoje świąteczne zdjęcie
pl.shortDescription: Zmień dowolne zdjęcie w świąteczny portret.
pl.longDescription: Wybierz zdjęcie, stuknij Kartka świąteczna, a Nano Banana doda swetry, choinkę i śnieg, zachowując twarze.

pt-BR.name: Sua foto de cartão festivo
pt-BR.shortDescription: Transforme qualquer foto num retrato festivo.
pt-BR.longDescription: Escolha uma foto, toque em Cartão festivo e o Nano Banana põe suéteres, árvore iluminada e neve, sem mudar rostos.

zh-Hans.name: 你的节日贺卡照
zh-Hans.shortDescription: 把任何照片变成温馨的节日肖像。
zh-Hans.longDescription: 选一张照片，点“节日贺卡”，Nano Banana 会加上毛衣、闪亮的圣诞树和雪花，每张脸都保持不变。

zh-Hant.name: 你的節日賀卡照
zh-Hant.shortDescription: 把任何照片變成溫馨的節日肖像。
zh-Hant.longDescription: 選一張照片，點「節日賀卡」，Nano Banana 會加上毛衣、閃亮的聖誕樹和雪花，每張臉都保持不變。
